pr_title: [StructuredAuthenticationConfig] Create struct for authn config and re-wire OIDC flags to use it
pr_body:
- Adds the `v1alpha1` API for `AuthenticationConfiguration`
- Wires up existing `--oidc-*` flags with the internal struct
  - The `AuthenticationConfiguration` validation is used after the struct is created.

Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/118832
Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/119384
